extDescription.message: An honest statement for your Steam account: spending, playtime, refunds, inventory and market. No tracking, data stays local.

footer.message: Vapor Ledger only talks to Steam. Your data stays in this browser. Not affiliated with Valve or Steam.

loadingStart.message: Asking Steam who is logged in...

loadingPrices.message: Loading market prices: {0} of {1} (about {2} min left)

rateLimited.message: Steam is limiting requests right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

loginText.message: Vapor Ledger uses the Steam login of this browser. Log in on the Steam store in another tab, then come back here.

communityLogin.message: You are not logged in on steamcommunity.com in this browser. Log in there to load inventory and market.

communityOtherAccount.message: Steam Community is logged in with a different account than the Steam store. Please use the same account on both.

tileSpentHint.message: purchases, gifts and in-game, minus refunds

tileBalanceHint.message: spent, minus market result and items (after fees)

tileOtherCurrenciesHint.message: not converted and not in the totals

noteEntries.message: {0} entries read from your purchase history, {1} games matched to a price.

noteHistoryIncomplete.message: Steam did not hand out the whole purchase history this time, so the totals may be too low. Load again from Steam to try once more.

noteCarts.message: {0} purchases had several items in one cart. Steam only shows the total for those, so they count for the total but not for single games.

noteCurrencies.message: All totals are in {0}. Purchases in other currencies are shown on their own and never added: {1}.

noteNoPrice.message: Games from keys, bundles or gifts have no price on Steam and show "-".

noteStoreValue.message: Store value today is what the games still for sale would cost in the store right now, including current discounts. Removed and free games are not counted.

noteNoStorePrices.message: Store prices could not be loaded this time. Load again from Steam to try once more.

notePrivacy.message: All data stays in your browser. Vapor Ledger only talks to Steam.

refundIntro.message: Steam usually refunds a game if you ask within {0} days of the purchase and played it less than {1} hours. These games from your purchase history still fit.

refundSteamDecides.message: Steam decides every request itself. Vapor Ledger never asks for a refund for you.

refundOldData.message: Your data is {0} old. Load again from Steam for the current playtime.

refundNone.message: No game from the last 14 days with less than 2 hours played.

refundOthersTitle.message: Other items from the last 14 days

refundOthersText.message: DLC, soundtracks and items that are not a game in your library. Steam checks the rules for these itself.

refundNoteGifts.message: Games you got as a gift can only be refunded by the person who bought them. Gifts you bought for others are not listed.

refundNoteDlc.message: DLC can usually be refunded within 14 days if the base game was played less than 2 hours since buying it, unless the DLC was used up or changed.

refundNoteIngame.message: In-game purchases are left out. Steam only refunds them in some games.

refundNoteNothingAutomatic.message: The playtime is the total Steam reports. Days are counted from the date in your purchase history.

worthIntro.message: Ranked by cost per hour, for the {0} games with a known price. Games played less than an hour count as one hour.

worthBestEmpty.message: No game with a known price and at least one hour played.

worthWorstEmpty.message: No game with a known price.

savingsTotalHint.message: {0} games bought below the regular price

savingsTodayNote.message: Steam's purchase history does not say what the regular price was on the day you bought a game. So this compares with today's regular price in the store, without today's discount. Prices change over the years, take it as a rough guide.

savingsOtherCurrency.message: The store shows prices in {0}, your purchases are in {1}. Vapor Ledger does not convert currencies, so there is no comparison.

chartBarsDescription.message: Bar chart with {0} bars. Focus it and use the arrow keys to read the values.

chartLineDescription.message: Line chart with {0} points. Focus it and use the arrow keys to read the values.

chartScatterDescription.message: Scatter chart with {0} games. Focus it and use the arrow keys to read the values.

chartKeyboard.message: Tip: every chart can be focused with Tab and read with the arrow keys. "Show as table" lists all values.

chartPlaytime.message: How long you played your games

chartNoPrices.message: No game with a known price yet.

recapIntro.message: Make an image of your Steam account to share. It is made in this browser and shows no Steam ID and no name. Game names are only on it if you tick the box.

recapFooter.message: Made with Vapor Ledger, a free browser extension for Steam

exportIntro.message: Save your data as files for a spreadsheet or your own tools. The files contain no Steam ID.

deleteIntro.message: Vapor Ledger keeps the loaded data in this browser, so the page opens quickly. You can delete it here at any time.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete everything Vapor Ledger has saved in this browser?

inventoryIntro.message: Inventory value and market history come from steamcommunity.com. Steam allows only about 20 market price requests per minute, so the first check of a big inventory takes a while. Prices are kept for a day.

marketEmpty.message: No market purchases or sales found.

tileMarketNetHint.message: sold minus bought, unsold items count as cost

notePrices.message: Prices are the lowest current listing on the Steam market and are kept for one day.

noteReceive.message: "You would get" subtracts the Steam and game fees from each price.

noteMarket.message: Market profit or loss uses the prices exactly as your market history shows them.

noteMarketIncomplete.message: The history is not complete yet, load again to get the rest.

noteNothingSold.message: Nothing is sold or listed automatically. All data stays in your browser.

settingsIntro.message: Vapor Ledger can make some of Steam's own pages easier to use. It only changes how they look and work in this browser. Saving and everything else still goes through Steam's own buttons. Each improvement can be switched off.

settingsReload.message: Changes apply the next time a Steam page is opened or reloaded.

set_headerLink.message: Vapor Ledger link in Steam's header

set_headerLink_hint.message: A link next to your account menu that opens this page.

set_profileEdit_hint.message: Steam's Save button stays in view, Ctrl+S saves, a warning before leaving with unsaved changes, character counters and a preview of your custom URL.

set_historyTools_hint.message: A search field, a type filter and "Load all", which clicks Steam's own "Load more" button for you, one page after another.

set_licensesTools_hint.message: A search field and a year filter for the long list of licenses and product keys.

peUrlEmpty.message: Without a custom URL your profile address uses your Steam ID.

peUrlRules.message: Steam usually allows 3 to 32 letters, digits, _ and -.
